name: triad
description: Tiered-model orchestration: Opus orchestrates, Sonnet codes, Haiku does menial work. The mod enforces the tiers and keeps a token ledger.

maxDepth.title: Max depth below the orchestrator
maxDepth.description: Spawns deeper than this are refused.

maxRetries.title: Max automatic retries per task
maxRetries.description: How many times a non-conforming reply is sent back before it is passed through.

strictMenu.title: Offer only Triad agent types
strictMenu.description: Hide and refuse built-in and other plugins' agent types, which would bypass the tiers.
